purpose: Batch-test whether keeping multiple GAP1 value horses improves a King1-anchored TRIO strategy without introducing odds-driven promotion.
value_candidate: distinct from anchor; market_rank-consensus_rank>=1; Outsider context available
value_order: p3 desc, rank gap desc, outsider score desc, consensus rank asc, market rank desc, horse_id asc
ticket_space: anchor fixed; unordered pair of non-anchor horses; ticket eligible for a pool when at least one partner is in that pool

probability_model: one shared model per walk-forward fold trained on ALL-pool eligible tickets
